starting_state: A validated source needs projection, a spec-to-code stage becomes eligible, generated output fails validation, or an artifact owner requests synthesis, productization, capitalization, or gate review.
preconditions: declared parameters, authority, criteria, ownership, license, review, attestation, reuse, and separation requirements appropriate to the target stage.
intention: Derive, project, promote, or quarantine artifacts through explicit, evidence-backed maturity gates without skipping stages.
job: Select an exact source and transformation, validate the result, keep generated output distinct from runtime readiness, and prove each maturity transition and lineage link.
authority_requirements: Attributable actor context and role resolution
Policy digest binding against active snapshot
expected_consequential_state_transitions: Source becomes validated derived output or quarantined output
cognitive becomes intellectual, intellectual becomes product, and product becomes capital only through legal transitions
generated contract remains distinct from runtime-accepted binding.
settlement_condition: The output is either validated, hash-linked, and settled at its actual maturity or quarantined with typed reasons; every transition preserves provenance and no file creation alone claims runtime readiness.
expected_next_decisions_and_affordances: advance to the next legal stage
implement and settle a runtime binding
applicable_failure_and_recovery_behavior: Quarantine malformed, invalid, drifted, or unverifiable output
repair missing semantic, evidence, review, ownership, license, attestation, reuse, or approval gates
re-run from the last valid predecessor.
